Style/medium: Special hand-painted animation ending still, pencil crosshatching, rough dry brush, gouache paper grain, expressive ink contours, warm amber lit areas with desaturated teal shadows. Restrained and quiet ending, no attack effects.
Composition/framing: Horizontal wide 16:9, full illustration to the edges, clear silhouette and eyes, recognizable same character. One continuous scene. NO lettering, logos, captions, frames, split-screen, flash, motion trails, blood, broken floor, detached body parts, extra arms, swords, cape or armor.
